title: Agent Runtime Harness — tools section
description: The `tools:` map of the runtime config. Keys are tool ids.

type.description: Adapter type. `command` runs any host executable; `unity` is the Unity batchmode adapter.

version.description: Tool version, used by requirement resolution.

executable.description: Absolute path or PATH-lookup name. For macOS .app bundles use the binary inside Contents/MacOS/.

version_command.description: Args appended to the executable for `tool doctor` / `version` command.

env.description: Per-tool environment overrides; win over the session env.

capabilities.description: Advertised subcommands, e.g. run, test.editmode, build.
